mgmt_team_view.text: In December 2025 the company obtained regulatory approval of Master Development Programs for all 13 airports for 2026-2030, with committed investments of Ps.16,005 million, a commitment management described as comparable in real terms to the prior cycle despite materially higher traffic, implying improved capital efficiency per passenger. Shareholders approved a Ps.4,900 million cash dividend in two installments during 2026 and a Ps.1,500 million Series B repurchase reserve. First-quarter 2026 traffic rose 4.7% and adjusted EBITDA reached Ps.2,421 million, though net income fell 4.1% as costs rose 19.1%.
